gate_g16_sign_functions.claim: each kind's cheap sign function has its region's sign at drawn points beyond the comparison's rounding, and its stated gradient's length is its value's within 64 units in the last place, within half its smallest length of the boundary
gate_g16_sign_functions.case: tests/scene/test_sign_functions.py (six kinds: sphere, capsule, cylinder, ellipsoid, screw, helix)

prediction.why: each is its region's exact signed distance (or, the ellipsoid's and the screw's thread, the region's defining inequality with its analytic gradient); the helix's held angle converges from the right turn in 3 Newton steps inside the filament and any angle gives the right sign outside it

control.plant: SIGN_PLANT=sign (the sign flipped within a tenth of the smallest length of the boundary) and SIGN_PLANT=slope (the gradient's length 10 % long)
control.resolution: a flip of a band 0.1 x the smallest length wide is caught at every drawn set of 288 points or more; the slope at 10 % against 64 ulps

gate_g16_sign_functions.if_wrong: a sign mismatch names the kind and point; the kind's sign function is fixed before route 2 images it
gate_g16_sign_functions.cannot_discriminate_if: no drawn point lies within the flipped band (the near-surface draws make this impossible by construction)

gate_g18_swap.claim: route 2 images the sphere and the capsule as route 1 does: per pixel within 2e-3 of a pixel's share and the silhouette's motion within 2e-3 relative, in float64 and float32

prediction.why: their sign functions are their exact distances; the held point is the parabola's vertex, read at the second order (seen locally below 1e-4)

gate_g18_swap.metric: largest per-pixel difference, and the relative difference of the darkness's and its centroid's derivatives in x and z

control.plant: CAMERA_PLANT=sampled-slope: the march's first-order distance 10 % short
control.resolution: a 10 % distance error moves a silhouette pixel by up to 0.05 of its share at these radii (21 and 11 px), 25 times the line

gate_g18_swap.if_wrong: route 2 departs from route 1 where both are exact: a defect in the march or the pieces
gate_g18_swap.cannot_discriminate_if: both routes NaN (the test reads finite numbers)

gate_chord.claim: an attenuating sphere's absorbed light by route 2's chord is within 1e-3 relative of route 1's

prediction.unit: relative difference of the summed darkness
prediction.why: linear interpolation of the crossings; a grazing ray's chord is off by up to a spacing, a small share of the frame's darkness

control.resolution: 10 % of the chord moves the absorbed light by several per cent at an attenuation of 2000 per metre

gate_chord.if_wrong: the chord's interpolation or masks are wrong; per-pixel figures name where

gate_corner.claim: the located error's fix on the coil, whose turns cross in its image: on every pixel where two branches of the outline cross (both pieces within the corner reach), route 2 is within 0.04 of the sign-only truth; the single edge (the second branch dropped) is not, on some such pixel, at every drawn pose
gate_corner.operating_point: float64; the truth at 32 x 32 jittered samples a pixel and 512 signs (its floor under 0.02 a pixel, camera truth 1)

prediction.unit: largest error on the two-branch pixels (the fix)
prediction.why: the line is twice the corner sub-samples' worst on the screw's located pixels and every off-cap pixel (0.0197, run 43607018230), declared before the rate run, never refitted; the coil's crossings are X-shaped, four concave corners each, about 4 to 8 crossings in view, so a single edge misses a share near a quarter at the worst of them

control.clean_expected: 0/30 (the fix within the line at every draw)
control.resolution: the plant is judged on the two-branch pixels of each draw, where its miss reaches about a quarter of a pixel; if it dips under the line on a draw the oracle is sharpened (more poses a draw), never the line lowered

gate_corner.if_wrong: a clean flag is a pixel the fix leaves over 0.04 on the coil, a finding against the line's basis; a missed plant names the draw
gate_corner.cannot_discriminate_if: a draw with no two-branch pixel (the test asserts some)

gate_held_derivative.claim: a held branch's derivative converges on the least first-order distance's along the ray, at the second order in the samples' spacing

prediction.why: the parabola's vertex error is second order in the spacing; the envelope's rule then holds to that

gate_held_derivative.if_wrong: the stop_gradient on the march is not cleared, and the camera's status would be capped

gate_g19_cost.claim: the structural cost estimate (rays x sub-frames x evaluations a ray x one evaluation's flops-equivalents from XLA's cost analysis) predicts the in-loop camera's measured frame time within a factor of 3 over three detector sizes, read as an effective rate
gate_g19_cost.case: probe: node_measure.py through built.run on an in-loop coil with frame_period one step, at 160 x 120, 320 x 240 and 640 x 480, float32 and float64

prediction.value: an effective rate of 5 to 30 G flops-equivalents a second, its spread over the sizes within 3 x
prediction.why: camera optimisation 1 measured the same structure at 15 to 20 G a second; the corner sub-samples, counted as running on every ray, may not run on a frame without a corner, so the estimate is an upper bound on the work

gate_g19_cost.if_wrong: the warning's line (1e9 a frame, about 50 to 70 ms) is restated from the measured rate in a later commit, said so

gate_g20_helix.claim: the march converges on the coil at its declared count: from N to 2N the image moves by under 0.02 of a pixel's share at any pixel and the silhouette's motion by under 1 %; against the sign-only truth, the motion is within 1 % at a straight and a tilted pose, judged on the darkness and both centroid components

prediction.unit: relative motion error against the truth
prediction.why: the coil has no crease; camera truth 1 found the first-order march within 1 % off the crease at 32 samples on FL-9, whose features are fatter in samples than the coil's at its count

control.plant: the gradient's length 10 % long (a stand-in kind) fails the truth in z or focal motion; the count planted at 8 samples fails the N to 2N line
control.expected_rate: deterministic poses: fails at both poses

gate_g20_helix.if_wrong: the count rule (SPACING, half the smallest feature) is raised and said so

prediction.why: the window holds the enclosing ball's silhouette with a margin; each pixel's march is its own

control.plant: CAMERA_PLANT=small-window: the window at 0.3 of its size

gate_g20_helix.run: 43621534090 G20 (the coil at 128 x 96, the march's count 48 and 95, straight and tilted poses, the truth at 32 x 32 samples a pixel and 512 signs, motion by central differences at a quarter pixel, truth 1's vector: equivalent radius and centroid)
gate_g20_helix.controls: eight samples: image 1.0 and 0.78, motion 4 to 33 % off the converged march (caught); the offset plant: image 0.20 and 0.195 against the truth (caught in the image), motion unchanged (an offset does not move a translation's derivative: the control tests the image, not the motion)
gate_g20_helix.reading: N to 2N: the image moves 0.002 at most (line 0.02) and the motion 0.4 % at most (line 1 %). Against the truth the motion is within 1 % in 3 of the 4 pose and axis entries (0.28, 0.82 and 0.88 %) and NOT at the straight pose in x: 1.6 %, which does not change from 48 to 95 samples (1.61 to 1.63 %) and which the march's own jvp shows against its own central difference (1.7 %), so it is not the sample count; the cause is not established (candidates: the central difference's own error across the coverage's kinks at a quarter-pixel step, a held-point derivative bias at this pose). The prediction (0.5 %, line 1 %) held at three entries and failed at one; the camera's G20 is therefore stated as: converged in the count, within 1 % against the truth except 1.6 % in x at the straight pose, cause open. The truth's own image floor reads 0.045 and 0.089 at the largest pixel (the truth bounds the march only where its error exceeds the floor)
